as_told.title: Dead binary companion star approaching the Sun, cycle seen in ice cores
as_told.place_text: Solar system / Antarctica and Greenland ice cores

plain: This story is about an idea that our Sun has a hidden partner, a dead star that it circles with. A researcher on ancient history named Matt LaCroix tells it on a podcast with the host Jesse Michels. He says this partner is the entire reason for the Great Year, a long sky cycle of roughly 12,500 years in his telling, and for the times when human civilisations have been wiped out and had to start over. LaCroix says the American space agency, NASA, has covered this up, and he points to a 1987 book called the New Science Encyclopedia. Later in the same conversation he adds that the cycle shows up in ice drilled from Antarctica and Greenland. He also says the partner star is close again now, and that 'we're right in it right now,' though there he does not mention NASA. If true, it would mean another reset of civilisation could be coming soon.
